name: Systemd Inspector
author: brunonlinespace
description: Read-only systemd inspector for system/current-user runtime units and installed unit files, with radio-selected inventory mode, filter-row System/User manager scope, persistent Runtime Units failed-only filtering, whole-manager state/default-target/properties/unit-path/job inspection, unit-type and state filtering, live status, cgroup/runtime state, recent journal, complete systemctl show properties, native Requirements/Reverse/After/Before dependency traversal, unit-file provenance/effective fragments and drop-ins, focused service runtime outcome/lifecycle fields, native Timer/Socket/Path analysis, resource controls, sandbox settings, and optional systemd-analyze security output.
